name: carrier_beside
_comment: Wave 6, B NPC carrier take 3: the hostile STOCK Fed Carrier (gövt 362) is a mission ship that starts at Kit Port beside the player (mïsn 1001, pilot w6_carrier_beside; mïsn 1002 is the anchored Speed-0 copy, pilot w6_carrier_anchored), with kits/viper_blast.mjs so its Vipers carry the 400 px Kit Blast Shell.
